English: Palm Frond Hut
Simple shelters woven from palm fronds, offering basic cover and a first step toward taming the jungle.
Cleared Patch
A patch of jungle cleared for communal gathering, basic work, and initial livestock. Slightly improves clan organization and space.
Raised Platform Tent
Tents on wooden platforms, elevated above the damp jungle floor to protect from pests and flooding. Allows for greater population and mobility.
Mosquito Net Pavilion
Large communal tents covered in fine netting to keep out jungle insects. Improves health, unity, and survival in the humid environment.
Jungle Stockade
A rough wooden palisade encircling the camp, built from felled jungle timber. Provides defense and improved security.
Rain Shelter
Layered canopies and drainage ditches protect the camp from tropical downpours, enabling higher population and supply.
Jungle Watchstand
Raised wooden towers allow sentries to observe the jungle canopy and warn the clan of dangers, improving unity and security.
Timber Clearing
A broad swathe of jungle is cleared and harvested for timber, supporting advanced construction and greatly increasing camp capacity.
Jungle Bastion
A mighty timber-and-earthwork fortification, blending with the jungle terrain. Serves as both a last redoubt and symbol of clan unity.
Rainforest Refuge
A sprawling, fortified camp fully adapted to the rainforest, with advanced shelters, watchtowers, and escape routes. The ultimate jungle nomad stronghold.
